purpose: Dashboard display only: groups AU meetings as 都會 / 省級 / 鄉鎮 by racecourse. The scoring engine has its own per-meeting classification (au_track_geometry.json) and does not read this file.
rule: Venues listed under metropolitan or provincial for their state take that tier; every other venue is country. Keys are au_racing_engine.engine_core._track_geometry_key slugs, so the engine's alias table (Rosehill Gardens, Randwick-Kensington, Illawarra Grange ...) applies without a second copy.

sources.NSW: Racing NSW: four Sydney metropolitan tracks (Australian Turf Club) and the five PRANSW provincial clubs - https://www.racingnsw.com.au/nsw-race-clubs/provincial-clubs/
sources.VIC: Racing Victoria apprentice-claim classification from 1 Aug 2023: all racetracks at Flemington, Caulfield, The Valley and Sandown are Metropolitan; Provincial is Bendigo, Cranbourne, Geelong, Mornington, Sale, Ballarat (turf), Pakenham (turf) and Warrnambool; everything else is Other - https://www.racingandsports.com.au/news/racing/news/2023-07-13/updated-claiming-system-for-vic-apprentices/619404
sources.QLD: Brisbane Racing Club (Eagle Farm, Doomben) meetings are Metropolitan in Racing Australia notices; Racing Queensland's SEQ provincial clubs are Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich and Toowoomba (RQ Thoroughbred Handicapping Procedure 2025: Provincial One = SEQ provincial meetings). Matches Racing Australia Acceptances 'Meeting Type'.
sources.SA: Racing SA Local Rules: Metropolitan = South Australian Jockey Club (Morphettville) and Oakbank; Provincial = Balaklava, Strathalbyn, Gawler, Murray Bridge; Port Lincoln and Mount Gambier reclassified to Country from 2026/27 - https://racingsa.com.au/files/20684_updated_local_rules_250823.pdf
sources.WA: Perth Racing is WA's only metropolitan club (Ascot, Belmont Park) - https://www.rwwa.com.au/clubs/perth-racing-ascot/ ; provincial = venues whose Racing Australia results pages give 'Meeting Type: Provincial' (checked 2026-11-01 on up to three recent meetings each: Albany, Bunbury, Geraldton, Kalgoorlie, Northam, Pinjarra Park, Pinjarra Scarpside, York; Kalgoorlie's Cup day is labelled Metro). Broome, Carnarvon, Collie, Laverton, Leinster and Toodyay are labelled Country.
sources.TAS: Racing Australia results pages label Hobart, Launceston and Devonport Tapeta Synthetic meetings 'Meeting Type: Metro' (checked 2026-11-01, three recent meetings each), so all three are metropolitan.
sources.ACT: Canberra: Racing Australia results pages give 'Meeting Type: Country' (checked 2026-11-01, three recent meetings).
sources.NT: No metropolitan or provincial venue published; all NT venues are country.
